messages.text: Thanks, the iPhone is connected (I can see it, iOS 26.6.1). Next: (1) I build the safe screen recorder (ioscap) and post one console step for its first run, where you watch the Mac's camera light: it must stay off; (2) the fwreskip G2 re-test you chose in PR-005; (3) the P-065 word-alone blocks. Each step that needs you comes to the console.

A correction on the screen recorder first run (C-025). You pressed Done at 21:31:54, but the 20 s recording actually ran 21:32:11-21:32:35, after that, because I sent messages to three agents before starting it. So you watched the light before the recording, not during it. What the recorder logged: it opened exactly one device, 'iOS Device' (Apple), refused 0 others, and the Camera permission was already 'authorized', which is why you saw no prompt. I don't know when that was granted (an older build was denied twice on 10-01); you can check or switch it off under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera ('ioscap'). Do you want a 20 s re-run where recording starts within a few seconds of your Start, so you can watch the light during it? The phone is running the fwreskip G2 test now (about 25 min); I can interrupt it for the re-run, or do it right after.

camera light is OFF. 

fyi: i was see the claude code harness request me to approve to run the command.

Thanks. That settles it: the permission prompt you approved was my record command, so you were watching while it ran, and the camera light stayed off. No re-run needed. The first run is recorded as passed (only the iPhone screen opened, 0 other devices). Phone tests continue: fwreskip G2 now, then the P-065 blocks.
